intro: info@magicaleastafricaheritagesafaris.com

This 4-day safari takes you from the scenic Great Rift Valley to the world-famous Masai Mara. Begin with the iconic pink flocks of flamingos and rhinos of Lake Nakuru National Park, then continue to Masai Mara—Kenya’s most celebrated reserve, home to the Big Five and breathtaking savannah landscapes. Enjoy extraordinary game drives, comfortable accommodations, and expert guiding throughout your wildlife adventure.
highlights: Lake Nakuru

Rhino Sanctuary: Lake Nakuru National Park is Kenya's first government-protected rhino sanctuary and a major highlight. It hosts one of the largest concentrations of the critically endangered Eastern black rhino and a thriving population of Southern white rhino
Rare Rothschild's Giraffe: The park is a sanctuary for the endangered Rothschild's giraffe, which was translocated here for its protection.
The Big Five (minus one): The park is home to four of the "Big Five" game animals: lions, leopards, rhinos, and buffaloes. Elephants are not present due to the park's perimeter fencing.
Makalia Falls : Located in the southern part of the park, these picturesque seasonal waterfalls offer a tranquil setting for picnics and birdwatching, especially after the rains.
Masai Mara
The Great Migration (Seasonal): If traveling between July and October, witness the epic river crossings of millions of wildebeest and zebra across the Mara River.
Big Cat Sightings: The Mara is renowned for guaranteed sightings of lions, cheetahs, and leopards—it is one of the best places in the world to see predators in action.
Big Five & More: A near-certainty to spot the "Big Five" (lion, leopard, elephant, rhino, buffalo) and countless other species.
Hot Air Balloon Safari (Optional): Start your day with a breathtaking sunrise flight over the plains, followed by a champagne breakfast in the bush.

Lake Naivasha
Boat Safari: Cruise the freshwater lake for close encounters with hippos that bob on the surface and vast colonies of majestic birds, including African Fish Eagles.

Crescent Island Walking Safari: Enjoy a guided walk among grazing animals (giraffes, zebras, and various antelopes) in a safe, open environment—a unique highlight where you are on foot with the wildlife.
Great Rift Valley Views: The drive to Naivasha provides spectacular, sweeping views as you descend into the valley floor.
Masai Mara
The Great Migration (Seasonal): If traveling between July and October, witness the epic river crossings of millions of wildebeest and zebra across the Mara River.
Big Cat Sightings: The Mara is renowned for guaranteed sightings of lions, cheetahs, and leopards—it is one of the best places in the world to see predators in action.
Big Five & More: A near-certainty to spot the "Big Five" (lion, leopard, elephant, rhino, buffalo) and countless other species.

days.title: Mombasa / Nairobi → Tsavo East National Park
days.text: • Morning: Depart early from Mombasa or Nairobi and drive to Tsavo East National Park , famous for its large herds of red elephants and endless savannah. Enter through Bachuma or Voi Gate. • Mid-morning: Enjoy your first game drive en route to the lodge or camp. • Afternoon: After lunch, embark on an extended game drive where you may spot lions, cheetahs, elephants, buffalo, zebras, and numerous antelopes. • Overnight: Tsavo East (Lodge or Camp)

days.title: Tsavo East → Tsavo West National Park
days.text: Early Morning: Enjoy a sunrise game drive when predators are most active. Mid-Morning: Exit the park and head to Tsavo West , known for its rugged scenery, volcanic hills, and lava flows. Afternoon: Visit Mzima Springs , a freshwater oasis home to hippos and crocodiles. You may also explore the Shetani Lava Flow and enjoy a game drive in the rhino sanctuary (chance to spot the endangered black rhino). Overnight: Tsavo West (Lodge or Camp)

days.title: Tsavo West → Amboseli National Park
days.text: Morning: Depart after breakfast for Amboseli National Park , arriving in time for lunch. Afternoon: Go on a game drive across Amboseli’s open plains, famous for elephants and stunning views of Mount Kilimanjaro. Look out for lions, cheetahs, hyenas, giraffes, buffalo, and plenty of bird species. Overnight: Amboseli National Park (Lodge or Camp)

days.title: Amboseli → Nairobi / Mombasa
days.text: Early Morning: Take a final game drive in Amboseli—this is the best time for clear views of Mount Kilimanjaro and active wildlife. Mid-Morning: Exit the park and start the journey back to Nairobi or Mombasa (via Emali or Tsavo route). Drop-off: At your preferred location. You may choose to begin and end the tour in Nairobi, or start in Nairobi and finish in Mombasa if you plan to enjoy a beach extension along the Kenyan Coast.
